{"task": {"role": "You read the description of an outfit and list its items as data.", "rules": ["One object per item — garment, shoes, bag, accessory, jewelry — in the order of the description, with its words and hex.", "One item carries one thing — of two alternatives list the first; a note in brackets is not an item.", "Slot "accessory" is for an item no other slot fits.", ""is_outfit" says whether the description is an outfit: no — when in place of items it has a refusal, a question or a note."], "limits": ["Rely only on the input: do not invent what it does not contain.", "The answer is one JSON object following "answer_schema", without explanations and without ```."], "language": "English", "answer": "ITEM_LIST", "answer_schema": {"is_outfit": "yes|no", "items": [{"name": "<what the item is>", "details": "<its cut, length and fabric>", "slot": "top|bottom|dress|set|outerwear|shoes|bag|scarf|headwear|belt|tights|socks|jewelry|earrings|collar_necklace|necklace|brooch|bracelet|ring|glasses|gloves|watch|swimwear|underwear|accessory", "color_hex": "<#rrggbb or null>", "worn": "<true, or false when the description says the outfit goes without it>"}]}, "input": [""description" — the outfit description"]}, "description": "Midi silk slip dress, A-line silhouette with a subtle V-neckline and spaghetti straps, color Midnight Blue (#0A192F), flowing liquid satin with a soft drape.
Strappy leather sandals, pointed toe with a 3-inch block heel for stability, color Navy (#152342), smooth calfskin with a comfortable platform sole.
Pearl drop earrings, classic baroque pearls on an 18k white gold setting, color White (#FFFFFF).

This outfit honors your need to avoid overthinking your style while ensuring comfort during your recovery, as the fluid silk fabric moves gently with every breath without feeling restrictive. The midi length and block heel provide security and ease, allowing you to feel grounded and confident rather than forced into a rigid pose. A touch of pearl jewellery adds a refined elegance that complements your partner's tuxedo without competing for attention, creating a harmonious yet personal look suitable for this charitable evening."}
